title: Premature truncation of short help at abbreviations
answers: Why does Click command short help truncate early at abbreviations like vs. or e.g.?
How does Click determine the first sentence for default short help?
Short help message cuts off prematurely before the end of the sentence in CLI output
body:
Symptom: CLI command short help cuts off prematurely at abbreviations like "vs." or "e.g." instead of showing the full sentence.
Root cause: src/click/utils.py:_make_default_short_help treated any word ending in a period as the end of the sentence.
Fix pattern: Terminate the sentence only when a trailing period ends the text or the subsequent word does not start lowercase, then truncate using textwrap.shorten with break_on_hyphens=False.
Constraints: Relies on case heuristics where abbreviation continuations are lowercase; abbreviations followed by uppercase letters, digits, or symbols are still treated as sentence ends.
applies: Short help text generation in src/click/utils.py
says: Command summary text cuts off early in help listings when descriptions include common abbreviations.
Help screen prematurely truncates command descriptions at abbreviation periods instead of sentence ends.
Short command summaries should not split mid-sentence when containing abbreviations like versus or example.
Overview listing clips command descriptions in the terminal before the sentence actually finishes.
Display the full first sentence in command overviews even if abbreviations contain periods.
